column1: # Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter (01001E9023920000, update 1.0.6.1, v393216), SDK 19.3.13, NVN: Falcom's SORA engine.
# Brought up from the NSP script's survey and provisional profile on the Mac (docs/agents); the iPhone build has not been run on a device yet.
# every module main imports from; subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie, sdk is the same SDK 19.3.13 build as Octopath Traveler 0's
# The NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main sets a heap: the heap check reads a 0x81200000 request, so the heap region is 2.125 GB.
# The engine reserves a 3.375 GB address region for itself at start-up (its own 12.1 GB reservation cut by patches.py), and the SDK's node area sits at the start of
# the alias region, so the alias region is 4 GB and the guest block 6.625 GB of virtual address space (about 3 GB resident: the heap is what the game touches).
